answer.summary: A restored End city of ten buildings in one street-laid zone: a grand spire keep on high ground, two slender spire towers, three small dwellings, a gathering hall, a shulker vault, a ship dock at the edge and a workshop. A stepped central terrace is cut near the founding stone. The bridges between dwellings wait for a later release.
